item.title: Are Xbox and Playground making the right move sticking so closely to Fable's history?

item.title: Final count for Stop Killing Games petition verifies 1.3 million of its 1.4 million signatures
item.description: Stop Killing Games volunteer Moritz Katzner has shared an update on the popular European Union Citizens' Initiative to its official subreddit. The EU has successfully verified 1,294,188 of Stop Killing Games' 1,448,270 signatures, easily clearing the one million minimum count it needed to move forward in the process.

item.title: PS5 Outsells PS3
item.description: Sony's latest video game console, the PlayStation 5, which is part of the ninth generation of video game consoles, has outsold the lifetime sales of the PlayStation 3, according to VGChartz estimates. The PS5 has sold an estimated 89.44 million units worldwide through December, while the PlayStation 3 sold 87.40 million units lifetime.
